usages.usage: 語言學習中的「跟讀」，跟著音檔或說話者重複
因緊張或害怕而僵住、說不出話
examples: So you won't 《freeze》 when you speak.

usages.usage: gone to waste 表示努力或時間白費
examples: All those hours of studying had gone to 《waste》.

usages.usage: 形容日子或事情困難、難熬
going to 的口語縮讀，常見於自然口說
examples: Native speakers say 《gonna》 instead of going to.

breakdowns.sentence: The upstairs neighbor had loud music playing all night long.
breakdowns.translation: 樓上的鄰居整晚都在大聲放音樂。

points.label: have + 受詞 + V-ing
points.note: 表示讓某個狀態持續發生，這裡是音樂一整晚都在播放。

breakdowns.sentence: I was too tired to do anything about it.
breakdowns.translation: 我太累了，沒力氣處理這件事。

points.label: too + 形容詞 + to V
points.note: 表示「太……以至於不能……」。

breakdowns.sentence: Language is meant for communication.
breakdowns.translation: 語言是為了溝通。

points.label: be meant for
points.note: 表示某物的目的或用途。

breakdowns.sentence: Let me tell you the story about what happened to me at the airport in Brazil.
breakdowns.translation: 讓我告訴你我在巴西機場發生的故事。

points.label: what 名詞子句
points.note: what 引導一個子句，整個子句當 about 的受詞。

breakdowns.sentence: I had studied some Portuguese before.
breakdowns.translation: 我以前學過一些葡萄牙語。

points.label: 過去完成式
points.note: 表示在另一個過去時間點之前已經做過的事。

breakdowns.sentence: I felt confident that I could speak in Brazil.
breakdowns.translation: 我覺得自己在巴西可以開口說。

points.label: 形容詞 + that 子句
points.text: confident + that + 主詞 + 動詞
points.note: that 子句說明「有信心」的內容。

breakdowns.sentence: I realized my phone didn't have any battery.
breakdowns.translation: 我發現手機沒電。

points.label: realize + 名詞子句
points.note: realized 後面接一個完整子句，說明意識到的內容。

breakdowns.sentence: I would just order a taxi.
breakdowns.translation: 我可以直接叫計程車。

points.label: would 表示過去觀點中的未來
points.note: 說話者在回憶過去，描述當時接下來打算做的事。

breakdowns.sentence: When I tried to form a full sentence, I felt like a failure.
breakdowns.translation: 當我要組成一句完整句子時，我覺得自己像個失敗者。

points.label: when 時間副詞子句
points.text: when + 主詞 + 動詞, 主句
points.note: when 子句說明「覺得失敗」發生的時間或情境。

breakdowns.sentence: If you're learning English and often feel stuck in real-life conversations, I completely understand.
breakdowns.translation: 如果你正在學英文，而且常常在真實對話中卡住，我完全理解。

points.label: if 條件句
points.text: If + 主詞 + 動詞, 主句
points.note: if 子句提出一種情況，主句說明在此情況下的反應。

breakdowns.sentence: That's why I want to share an English learning app.
breakdowns.translation: 這就是為什麼我想分享一款英文學習 app。

points.label: That's why + 子句
points.text: That's why + 主詞 + 動詞
points.note: 用來說明前面原因帶出的結果。

breakdowns.sentence: An app that focuses on real-life situations so you won't freeze when you speak.
breakdowns.translation: 一款專注於真實生活情境、讓你說話時不會僵住的 app。

points.label: so + 主詞 + will/won't
points.note: so 在這裡表示目的或結果：為了讓你不會僵住。

breakdowns.sentence: There's a learning roadmap based on real-life situations.
breakdowns.translation: 它有一個以真實生活情境為基礎的學習路線圖。

points.label: 過去分詞片語修飾名詞
points.note: based on... 簡化自 which is based on...，用來補充說明 roadmap。

breakdowns.sentence: Pay attention to how I pronounce the word reservation.
breakdowns.translation: 注意我怎麼發 reservation 這個字。

points.label: how 名詞子句
points.text: pay attention to + how + 主詞 + 動詞
points.note: how 子句當介系詞 to 的受詞，表示要注意的內容。

breakdowns.sentence: I need to practice these situations I find myself in when traveling.
breakdowns.translation: 我需要練習旅行時會遇到的這些情境。

points.label: 省略關係代名詞；when + V-ing
points.text: situations + I find myself in; when traveling
points.note: situations 後省略 that，when traveling 是 when I am traveling 的簡化。

breakdowns.sentence: See how it detects my mistakes and suggests natural expressions.
breakdowns.translation: 看它如何偵測我的錯誤，並建議自然的表達方式。

points.label: 祈使句 + how 名詞子句
points.text: See + how + 主詞 + 動詞
points.note: See 是祈使句，how 子句說明要觀察的內容。

breakdowns.sentence: I think painting human bodies is the hardest.
breakdowns.translation: 我覺得畫人體是最難的。

points.label: 動名詞當主詞
points.note: 動名詞片語可以當句子的主詞。

breakdowns.sentence: I hate it when it's packed.
breakdowns.translation: 我討厭那種人擠人的情況。

points.label: hate it when + 子句
points.text: hate + it + when + 主詞 + 動詞
points.note: it 先占受詞位置，後面的 when 子句說明討厭的情況。

breakdowns.sentence: Send them to me so I can see.
breakdowns.translation: 傳給我，讓我看看。

points.label: so + can 表目的
points.note: so 表示目的，說明傳照片的原因。

breakdowns.sentence: What are you going to do next weekend?
breakdowns.translation: 你下個週末要做什麼？

points.label: be going to 未來式
points.text: be + going to + 原形動詞
points.note: 用來談已計畫或即將發生的未來事情。

breakdowns.sentence: How long has it been since you saw them last?
breakdowns.translation: 你上次見他們是多久以前？

points.label: 現在完成式 + since
points.text: How long + has it been + since + 過去式
points.note: 用現在完成式詢問從過去某時到現在經過多久。

breakdowns.sentence: It's hard to find time to see friends.
breakdowns.translation: 要找時間見朋友很難。

points.label: It is + 形容詞 + to V
points.note: it 作形式主詞，真正的主詞是 to find time。

breakdowns.sentence: I've been slacking lately.
breakdowns.translation: 我最近一直在偷懶。

points.label: 現在完成進行式
points.note: 表示最近一段時間持續發生的狀態。

breakdowns.sentence: I'm also going to meal prep for the week, which sounds boring.
breakdowns.translation: 我也打算為這一週預先備餐，這聽起來很無聊。

points.label: which 非限定關係子句
points.note: which 指前面整件事，補充說明它聽起來無聊。

breakdowns.sentence: If you like this video, you'll probably like these two.
breakdowns.translation: 如果你喜歡這支影片，你大概也會喜歡這兩支。

points.label: 第一類條件句
points.text: If + 現在式, will + 原形動詞
points.note: 用現在式條件搭配 will，表示可能發生的結果。
